props.description: The icon to draw, by name: a Lucide name such as `chevron-right`, an alias, or a namespaced custom icon. A name no registry holds draws nothing.
props.name: name

props.description: The size: `sm` 16 px, `md` 20 px, `lg` 24 px. Left out, it is `md`, or the size the component holding it sets.
props.name: size

props.description: The colour role it is drawn in, `muted` included as on Text. Left out, it takes the colour of its surroundings: the text on web, the holder on native.
props.name: tone

props.description: What the icon means, read by screen readers. Left out or empty, the icon is decorative and hidden from them.
props.name: label

props.description: Whether it is drawn mirrored in right-to-left text. Left out, an icon that points the reading way (arrows, chevrons, panel sides, the external link: `isDirectionalIcon`) mirrors and any other does not; `false` keeps a directional one as drawn.
props.name: isMirroredInRtl

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref
